title: Applying for a permit
rule: Applications go on the prescribed form with the prescribed fee, signed by the applicant or a representative.
points: Most go to the forest manager of the reserve.
Timber for export, mining or prospecting, protected plants, tourism and export of other produce go to the Director.
The forest manager may ask for more information, publicity or consultation before deciding.
A list of applications must be displayed at least 14 days before the meeting, at the local authority and village council offices.
The forest manager keeps a register of applications that the public can inspect.
